comparison.objective: Loosen two bottle caps before loading their basket into an autoclave.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate two exposed caps, then push a basket into a chamber.
comparison.success_condition: Both caps reach at least 60 degrees loose before the basket enters; inserting a tightly capped bottle latches failure.
comparison.reason: Although both involve rotation and safe sequencing, this record has no fine recessed tool, moving socket, relocking, or iterative response-based commissioning.
